description: The Foundation AI Testing Hub (FAITH) is a benchmarking tool used to assess LLMs competency on (cybersecurity) knowledge/tasks.
commit_message:
Cherry-pick Changes for v0.4.0 (#90)

* Document cti-reasoning and cwe-prediction benchmarks in README (#535)

* Fix incorrect package name in BigQuery install instructions (#536)

The BigQuery quick-setup used 'pip install faith[bigquery]'. 'faith' is the
module/CLI name, not the distribution name, and an unrelated 'faith' package
exists on PyPI -- so that command silently installs it (downgrading requests
and urllib3) and only warns that the bigquery extra does not exist.

FAITH is not published to PyPI yet (see the TODO in 'Installing the FAITH
Package'), so use the editable source install the rest of the README uses.
Verified in a clean venv: the extra resolves, google.cloud.bigquery and
google.cloud.storage import, and the faith CLI runs.
